content: गुण {%a.%} Of good quality (गुणवान्); भ्राता कथं नाम मया गुणस्य भ्रातुर्वधं राम विरोचयेत <ls>Rām. 4. 24. 9</ls>.

गुणः [गुण्-अच्] .²1 A quality (good or bad); सुगुण, दुर्गुण; यदङ्गनारूपसरूपतायाः कञ्चिद्गुणं भेदकमिच्छतीभिः <ls>Śi. 3. 42</ls>. .²2 .³({%a%}) A good quality, merit, virtue, excellence; कतमे ते गुणाः <ls>Māl. 1</ls>; वसन्ति हि प्रेम्णि गुणा न वस्तुनि <ls>Ki. 8. 37</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 9</ls>, <ls n="R. 1.">22</ls>; साधुत्वे तस्य को गुणः <ls>Pt. 4. 108</ls>. .³({%b%}) Eminence. .²3 Use, advantage, good (with <ab>instr.</ab> usually), <ls>Pt. 5</ls>; कः स्थानलाभे गुणः <ls n="Pt.">2. 21</ls>; <ls>H. 1. 49</ls>; <ls>Mu. 1. 15</ls>. .²4 Effect, result, efficacy, good result; संभावनागुणमवेहि तमीश्वराणाम् <ls>Ś. 7. 4</ls>; गुणमहतां महते गुणाय योगः <ls>Ki. 10. 25</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">6. 7</ls>. .²5 .³({%a%}) A single thread or string. .³({%b%}) Thread, string, rope, cord, मेखलागुणैः <ls>Ku. 4. 8</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">5. 10</ls>; तृणैर्गुणत्वमापन्नैर्बध्यन्ते मत्तदन्तिनः <ls>H. 1. 32</ls>; यतः परेषां गुणग्रहीतासि <ls>Bv. 1. 9</ls> (where गुण also means ‘a merit’). .²6 The bow-string; गुणकृत्ये धनुषो नियोजिता <ls>Ku. 4. 15</ls>, <ls n="Ku. 4.">29</ls>; कनकपिङ्गतडिद्गुणसंयुतम् <ls>R. 9. 54</ls>. .²7 The string of a musical instrument; कलवल्लकीगुणस्वानमानम् <ls>Śi. 4. 57</ls>. .²8 A sinew. .²9 A quality, attribute, property in general; यादृग्गुणेन भर्त्रा स्त्री संयुज्येत यथाविधि <ls>Ms. 9. 22</ls>. .²10 A quality, characteristic or property of all substances, one of the seven categories of {%padārthas%} of the Vaiśeṣikas, (the number of these properties is 24). .²11 An ingredient or constituent of nature, any one of the three properties belonging to all created things; (these are सत्त्व, रजस् and तमस्); गुणत्रयविभागाय <ls>Ku. 2. 4</ls>; सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसंभवाः <ls>Bg. 14. 5</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 27</ls>. .²12 A wick, cotton thread; नृपदीपो धनस्नेहं प्रजाभ्यः संहरन्नपि . अन्तरस्थैर्गुणैः शुभ्रैर्लक्ष्यते नैव केनचित् .. <ls>Pt. 1. 221</ls>. .²13 An object of sense, (these are five रूप, रस, गन्ध, स्पर्श, and शब्द); गुणैर्गुणान्स भुञ्जान आत्मप्रद्योतितैः प्रभुः <ls>Bhāg. 11. 3. 5</ls>. .²14 Repetition, multiplication, denoting ‘folds’ or ‘times’, usually at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> after numerals; आहारो द्विगुणः स्त्रीणां बुद्धिस्तासां चतुर्गुणा . षड्गुणो व्यवसायश्च कामश्चाष्टगुणः स्मृतः .. <ls>Chāṇ. 78</ls>; so त्रिगुण; शतगुणीभवति becomes a hundred-fold, अध्यर्धगुणमाहुर्यं बले शौर्ये च केशव <ls>Mb. 11. 20. 1</ls>. .²15 A secondary element, a subordinate part (<ab>opp.</ab> मुख्य); न च गुणानुग्रहार्थं प्रधानस्यावृत्तिर्युक्ता <ls>ŚB. on MS. 12. 1. 4</ls>. .²16 Excess, abundance, superfluity; पराङ्मुखवधं कृत्वा कोऽत्र प्राप्तस्त्वया गुणः <ls>Rām. 4. 17. 16</ls>. .²17 An adjective, a word subordinate to another in a sentence. .²18 The substitution of ए, ओ, अर् and अल् for इ, उ, ऋ (short or long) and ऌ, or the vowels अ, ए, ओ and अर् and अल्. .²19 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) Quality considered as an inherent property of a {%Rasa%} or sentiment. Mammaṭa thus defines गुण.--ये रहस्याङ्गिनो धर्माः शौर्यादय इवात्मनः . उत्कर्षहेतवस्ते स्युरचलस्थितयो गुणाः .. <ls>K. P. 8</ls>. (Some writers on rhetoric, such as Vāmana, Jagannātha Paṇḍita, Daṇḍin and others, consider {%Guṇas%} to be properties both of शब्द and अर्थ, and mention ten varieties under each head. Mammaṭa, however, recognises only three, and, after discussing and criticizing the views of others, says: माधुर्यैजःप्रसादाख्यास्त्रयस्ते न पुनर्दश <ls>K. P. 8</ls>); <ls>Ki. 17. 6</ls>. .²20 (In <ab>gram.</ab> and <ab>Mīm.</ab>) Property considered as the meaning of a class of words; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} grammarians recognise four kinds of the meaning of words; जाति, गुण, क्रिया and द्रव्य, and give गौः, शुक्लः, चलः and डित्थः as instances to illustrate these meanings. .²21 (In politics) A proper course of action, an expedient. (The expedients to be used by a king in foreign politics are six:-- 1 सन्धि peace or alliance; 2 विग्रह war; 3 यान march or expedition; 4 स्थान or आसन halt; 5 संश्रय seeking shelter; 6 द्वैध or द्वैधीभाव duplicity; सन्धिर्ना विग्रहो यानमासनं द्वैधमाश्रयः <ls>Ak.</ls>) see <ls>Y. 1. 346</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 160</ls>; <ls>Śi. 2. 26</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 21</ls>. .²22 The number ‘three’ (derived from the three qualities). .²23 The chord of an arc (in <ab>geom.</ab>). .²24 An organ of sense. .²25 A subordinate dish; <ls>Ms. 3. 226</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 3.">233</ls>. .²26 A cook. .²27 An epithet of Bhīma as in युधिष्ठिरोऽपि गुणप्रियः <ls>Vās.</ls> .²28 Leaving, abandonment. .²29 A multiplier, coefficient (in <ab>math.</ab>) .²30 Division, subdivision, species, kind. .²31 The peculiar property of letters which are pronounced with external utterance (बाह्यप्रयत्न); they are eleven.  .{@-˚विभाग@} {%a.%} distinguishing an action and an attribute.
